description: This file defines a React component for rendering an interactive mind map canvas within a Next.js frontend application. It includes type definitions for nodes, edges, viewport, and component props, as well as functions for layout, zooming, and label wrapping.

methods.name: clamp
methods.description: Constrains a number to be within the specified min and max bounds.

methods.name: wrapLabel
methods.description: Wraps a string label into multiple lines with a maximum number of characters per line and lines overall, adding ellipsis if needed.

methods.name: computeRadialLayout
methods.description: Calculates radial layout positions for nodes based on their 'kind' and sorts recommended nodes around the current node.
